_comment: Profile for rendering on a CPU-only machine (a GitHub Actions runner).
Selected with SPATIALDATA_PROFILE=cloud. 3D terrain is kept on; the
settings below are what make it finish in software rendering instead of
stalling. Measured on a 12-core desktop with no GPU: 0.42 fps at these
settings with terrain, against 5.0 fps for the same track on the GPU.
A 4-core runner is roughly 3x slower again.
